scientific_choices.rationale: Reuse the practical frozen ResNet50 attention U-Net as a separate two-offset predictor; preserve the existing text model.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Learn a complementary spatial cue without changing text contours; benefit unknown.

scientific_choices.rationale: Every valid word pixel regresses normalized xy displacement to its visible raster centroid using tanh and word-balanced SmoothL1; zero-initialized vector head.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Dense word membership evidence, rather than sparse Gaussian center supervision; ignored/background pixels have no vector objective.

scientific_choices.rationale: Component-local probability-weighted bilinear voting, Gaussian accumulator smoothing, peak NMS and marker projection; dense votes within assignment_radius of a peak seed its word identity. Base probabilities alone define the optional flood shape and cost. Parameters are uncalibrated exploratory choices, not strict defaults.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Several convergent vote groups may separate a fused mask; false peaks can over-split it and weak peaks can be missed.

scientific_choices.rationale: Allow sequential base inference, saved aligned masks and independent auxiliary inference/training on the single GPU. Simultaneous feasibility and memory are unmeasured.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Avoid assuming two networks fit together in 8GB; placement and precision must be recorded per run.

scientific_choices.rationale: No offset checkpoint, matched held-out comparison, full official evaluation or physical GPU qualification exists for this extension.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Implementation and smoke evidence cannot establish improved separation or recognition.

scientific_choices.rationale: Qualified v4 TRAIN-only 1130/125 split and 512/256 letterbox, warm start from an explicitly SHA-bound practical single-output text checkpoint, 100 epochs; choose minimum word-balanced validation offset SmoothL1 with earliest ties. No TEST or OCR selects checkpoints.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Provides trained auxiliary vectors; offset validation alone does not establish improved separation.
